title: Pixel slice word reveal
summary: A flat blue hold snaps to a brand-pink frame, then band and column slices tear through a dot grid until one word assembles from coarse pink pixel blocks over a pale field, a small URL settling under it. Under 3 s, edgy.
use_when: A short tech or developer brand intro where the name is the only copy
A sting before or after a longer film, 2-3 s
Social loops that need a hard, digital-feeling reveal of one word
Silent autoplay where a colour snap has to stop the scroll

look.type_style: regular-weight grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking, one word centred, cap height ~12 % H; URL small (~2 % H) at ~85 % H

sfx.event: band and column slices tearing the frame

structure.shot: flat saturated blue field, empty; snaps to a full-frame brand-pink fill just before the cut
structure.motion: hold f0-f28 (no change in any cell); pink fill f28-f31, 3 fr, no easing (frame swap)

structure.shot: frame torn into horizontal bands: pale top third, blue below with thin blue rules, tiny pink pixel specks; then a blue bar on pale
structure.motion: bands swap every 2-4 fr, easings.linear frame steps (±0.25 s); specks 4-8 px at fixed positions

structure.shot: blue field with a 5x8 white dot grid and pink specks; then a 3-row mosaic of blue and pale column blocks with a pink pixel fragment of the word at centre
structure.motion: dot grid holds ~5 fr; column mosaic appears ~f45, blocks toggle blue/pale every 2-3 fr (±0.25 s); word fragment as pink blocks, letters offset

structure.shot: pale lavender field, one word centred in near-black, small URL near the bottom; last blue columns clear
structure.motion: 2 remaining columns gone by f53; word letters jump between offset positions with pink block overlays, resolved by f68 (±0.25 s); URL last letters offset and faded, settled by f83; hold to f87

params.brand: brand.json: bg (blue field), fg (word), accent (pink snap and pixel blocks), muted (pale field)
params.content.word: one word, the product name, 4-8 letters
params.content.url: small line under the word; defaults to brand.url
params.timing.hold: frames of the empty opening hold (default 28)
params.seed: seed for block and slice positions

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets and cut frames: cuts at f31, f38, f48; pink snap f28-f31 (near-miss score at 0.93 s). Every glitch state is a frame swap, not a tween: blocks and slices change on 2-3 fr steps. Opening is 1 s of nothing; keep it, the snap needs the empty hold. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): pixel-block-reveal, column-slice-mosaic, dot-grid. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Cut rate 1.03/s; energy left null because there is no music.
